column1: # Formulas where 012 matches Google Sheets on purpose (docs/contributing/testing.md).
# Tab-separated: formula, 012's result, Sheets' result, note.
# Results read "text" (quoted), 12.5, TRUE, #N/A, or (blank) for an empty cell.
# Sheets' result is "unconfirmed" until checked in Sheets. A row where it
# differs from 012's needs a note starting "on purpose:" that says why.
# Every formula computes one value; array results are measured with ROWS,
# COLUMNS, INDEX or TEXTJOIN. Data! is the fixture sheet (sheetscorpus_test.go).
